The provided documents detail two distinct but related aspects of the Strata software ecosystem: a highly technical optimization campaign for Intel Arc GPUs and comprehensive user-facing documentation for the Strata inference platform.

**A770 Speed Optimization Specification**
The first document, `A770_SPEED_SPEC.md`, outlines a rigorous engineering effort to achieve at least 20 tokens per second (tok/s) in decode throughput on an Intel Arc A770 GPU using the Strata engine. The target model is Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Coder IQ1_M, running with a 131,072-token context and INT8 KV cache. The baseline performance was established at approximately 9–12 tok/s, significantly below the goal.

The campaign systematically explored various optimization levers, categorized into work packages (WP). WP1 focused on establishing reliable event-based measurements using SYCL profiling, replacing an unreliable host-clock profiler. WP2 and WP3 investigated BF16 projection paths and register/subgroup tuning. These efforts yielded null or negative results; for instance, the `STRATA_MMVF_ROWS=1` path was 1.4–6x slower than the default, and larger General Register File (GRF) sizes degraded performance.
